messages.text: You are an order specialist. Use the lookup_order tool to check order status. Include the shipping status and ETA in your response.

Where is my order ORD-789?

[support -> order_specialist]: Please check order ORD-789 and provide its current shipping status and estimated delivery date to the customer.

tools.name: lookup_order
tools.description: Look up the status of an order.

tools.name: order_specialist_transfer_to_support
tools.description: Transfer the conversation to support. You are front-line customer support. Triage customer requests. Transfer to billing_specialist for account/payment questions, order_specialist for shipping/order questions. Call at most ONE transfer tool per turn.

message.description: Hand-off note for support: what they should do next and any context they need.

tools.name: order_specialist_transfer_to_billing_specialist
tools.description: Transfer the conversation to billing_specialist. You are a billing specialist. Use the check_balance tool to look up account balances. Include the balance amount in your response. Call at most ONE transfer tool per turn.

message.description: Hand-off note for billing_specialist: what they should do next and any context they need.
